setup: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev ca-certificates curl
warmup: mkdir -p data target && if [ ! -f web-vault/vw-version.json ]; then curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 120 https://github.com/dani-garcia/bw_web_builds/releases/download/v2026.10.1/bw_web_v2026.10.1.tar.gz -o target/web-vault.tar.gz && tar -xzf target/web-vault.tar.gz; fi
install: mkdir -p data target && if [ ! -f web-vault/vw-version.json ]; then curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 120 https://github.com/dani-garcia/bw_web_builds/releases/download/v2026.10.1/bw_web_v2026.10.1.tar.gz -o target/web-vault.tar.gz && tar -xzf target/web-vault.tar.gz; fi
